messages:
Alex K: Quick sync — pulling this week's regional GPU forecast and a cold-season load-shift sim. TL;DR: NA-shadow cluster runway goes <25% under the simulated 30% holiday uplift. Need mitigation proposals by EOD.
Maya S: Got it. Can you paste the per-cluster numbers? want to see which zones hit preemptible risk first :eyes:
Alex K: sure — rough numbers from the model (24h horizon, conservative tail):
- na-west1-prod: 48k GPU hours left (~22% runway)
- na-east1-burst: 62k GPU hours (~35% runway)
- eu-central: 75k GPU hours (~40% runway)
- apac-sg: 18k GPU hours (~18% runway) — high risk
Also background evals account for ~12% of token consumption in NA clusters.
Cheng L: apac-sg is the bottleneck. We've got limited quota there and spot churn spike projected. If spot preempts at 40% it's gone in ~8 hours under the sim.
Priya R: cost note — if we shift 20% of burst to eu-central and use reserved nodes for steady traffic, estimated incremental spend is +12% but reduces outage risk to <3%. Numbers based on current pricing curve.
Samir T: Ops suggestions: throttled rollout for non-critical evals, enable prefix-KV cache for repeat prompts, and schedule heavy batch evals to off-peak (00:00-06:00 UTC).
Maya S: +1. Also suggest enabling model fallback routing for apac->eu for short tail requests (<50 tokens) to preserve latency-sensitive traffic.
Alex K: Can we simulate fallback impact? Cheng, can you run a quick shift sim: move 25% of apac short tails to eu and 10% to na-east? If latency penalty <200ms, ok.
Cheng L: Running now — ETA ~25m. Quick note: network egress between apac and eu has occasional 10-15ms jitter; overall median added ~80ms in previous tests.
ops-bot: [automated] forecast_job/1766554321 started by Alex K — sim_id=sim-1766554321-a
Priya R: If fallback is used, enable traffic-based cost tags so we can attribute the extra egress and reserved node amortization.
Samir T: Runbook items I propose: 
1) Pause non-critical evals in apac (tag:evl-low)
2) Set fallback routing for short tails to eu (TTL 30m)
3) Temporarily increase reserved burst in na-east by 10 GPUs (if available)
4) Ops alert threshold at 20% runway -> auto-notify infra-oncall
I'll draft the change list.
Maya S: FYI, cache hit rates improved after last week's KV tuning — should expect ~6-8% effective token reduction if we enable broader caching for chat sessions.
Alex K: Cheng — results?
Cheng L: Sim done. Outcome: moving 25% short tails -> eu reduces apac-sg runway pressure from 18% -> 31%. Latency median added 95ms for those routed requests, p95 ~220ms. Cost delta estimated +7% for those requests (egress + reserved amortization). Full sim log gist: https://redwood-internal.gists/sim-1766554321
Priya R: Given cost vs risk, recommendation = enable routing for short tails to eu, pause low-priority evals in apac, and immediately enable cache widen (Maya to coordinate). Estimated net spend +5-8% but reduces critical outage risk to <1%.
Alex K: Sounds reasonable. Action owners: 
- Cheng: enable routing sim flag + monitor p95 for 6h
- Maya: KV cache rollout and instrumentation
- Samir: apply runbook alerts and temp reserved bump if quota allows
- Priya: update cost forecast and notify finance about potential +8% delta
Samir T: I'll also add an automated rollback if p95 > 300ms for 10m window.
Maya S: I'll start cache rollout in 10m and post progress here.
Cheng L: Routing flag on in staging, will gradually flip in prod in 10m increments, posting metrics to #infra-metrics.
Alex K: Great. We'll reconvene in the daily capacity sync tomorrow. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
ops-bot: [automated] forecast_job/1766554321 completed — sim_id=sim-1766554321-a, result=ok, duration=23m
